architecture.mechanism: Smart battery management systems that enhance resilience while maintaining energy density
architecture.intervention: Integrate a smart battery management system with machine learning-driven fault detection to continuously monitor parasitic drain currents, identify the specific module causing the drain, and isolate it to clear the ERC code and restore full vehicle speed.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of parasitic battery drain, clearance of the ERC dashboard code, and restoration of normal vehicle speed operation above 30 mph.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure battery state-of-charge over a 48-hour ignition-off period; if parasitic drain exceeds 50 mA or the ERC code reappears during subsequent driving, the intervention has failed.
